item.title: Pulitzer-Prize winning author honors civil rights icon at Binghamton University
item.description: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. (WIVT/WBGH) - A Pulitzer-Prize winning author spoke in Binghamton to honor a civil rights icon. Historian and Author Edda Fields-Black wrote Combee, a book about Harriet Tubman's civil war service to the U.S. Army. She spoke at Binghamton University's Downtown Center on February 24th.
